Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. Your work will focus on complex challenges in resiliency, asynchronous workflows, automation, and system scalability. We value engineers with deep technical fundamentals who are eager to adapt to evolving architectures, new languages, and emerging cloud-native technologies. What's Cool About This Job Build, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and platform capabilities. Develop and integrate APIs using established service and architecture patterns. Work with relational data stores and contribute to reliable data access and service integration patterns. Contribute to event-driven and asynchronous workflows, including message-based processing and background jobs. Run and support services across cloud and platform environments, including managed cloud services, containers, virtual machines, and other runtime models. Use CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code workflows to deliver changes safely and repeatably. Use logs, metrics, and traces to understand application behavior and diagnose production issues. Participate in technical design discussions, ADRs, RFCs, and code reviews, asking questions and contributing practical implementation feedback. Own defined areas of work and collaborate with more experienced engineers on broader architectural or cross-team decisions. Use AI-assisted engineering tools to speed up development, improve testing, explore codebases, and investigate technical problems. Cloud & Platform Engineering: Practical exposure to public cloud or modern platform environments. Experience with either GCP or AWS is valuable. Distributed Systems & Architecture: You should understand the fundamentals of distributed systems and have practical exposure to event-driven systems, asynchronous processing, and scalability. DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and monitoring using logs and metrics to diagnose issues. Security: Familiarity with Identity and Access Management, authentication/authorization fundamentals, and basic cloud security practices. Engineering Practices: Application of sound engineering practices like SOLID principles, automated testing, and technical documentation. AI-Assisted Engineering: Thoughtful use of modern AI tools to accelerate implementation, explore code, and support debugging while maintaining technical ownership. Helpful Experience To Have Languages & Runtimes: Go, PHP, Ruby, Python. Cloud Services: GCP, AWS, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, GKE, EC2, S3. Orchestration & Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform. review_candidates.title: Senior Core Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: If you’re a skilled backend engineer who thrives on solving complex production challenges, passionate about high-availability infrastructure, and ready to lead technical resolution for real-time sports experiences, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. What Your Day Will Look Like As a Senior Core Software Engineer at Beyond Sports, you’ll play a vital role in ensuring the resilience, scalability, and integrity of our global backend platforms. You will lead high-severity production incident responses, perform root cause analyses, and develop long-term solutions that keep our live systems operating seamlessly. Each day, you’ll collaborate with backend developers, infrastructure specialists, and product teams to safeguard our production environments. You’ll be hands-on: diving deep into distributed systems, debugging complex core codebase issues, optimizing database queries, and managing live data streaming pipelines. You will work to build preventative monitoring and proactive automation. Whether you are crafting automated end-to-end integration scripts, establishing robust alerting pipelines in Grafana or Prometheus, or mentoring junior team members on operational best practices, you’ll be an essential pillar in maintaining world-class system reliability. This role is to work What We Value At Beyond Sports, we move fast, aim high, and never settle. We believe in technical excellence, proactive ownership, and collaborative problem-solving, giving you the autonomy to architect reliable systems while supporting you with a team that’s as passionate as you are. You’ll fit right in if you: Love debugging complex backend systems and making production architectures bulletproof. Are collaborative and communicative, bridging the gap between technical teams and business stakeholders seamlessly. Thrive in high-stakes environments where real-time streaming and high data ingestion demand sharp, decisive action. Take pride in writing clean automation scripts, runbooks, and preventative tooling. Are eager to mentor others and elevate the operational maturity of the entire team. Tech Stack And Skill Requirements You don’t need to tick every box, but here’s what we’re looking for: Experience: Proven track record operating and troubleshooting distributed systems at scale. Infrastructure & Cloud: Strong experience with AWS (ECS, CDK, Lambda, Cognito, CloudFront) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) workflows. Real-time Data: Practical experience handling streaming architectures like Kafka or RabbitMQ. Programming & DBs: Proficiency in object-oriented programming (e.g., C# .NET) to debug codebases, paired with strong SQL and database optimization skills. Observability: Hands-on experience with monitoring frameworks like Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Datadog. CI/CD & Automation: Good understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines and scripting for automated integration testing. Bonus: Direct experience working in real-time sports technology or media streaming architectures. Why Level Up Your Career at Beyond Sports: Fast-paced. High-impact. Zero boredom. We move quickly, ship often, and build backend systems that handle massive live sports data. Build with freedom. Scale with purpose. You won’t just put out fires—you’ll establish long-term reliability standards and see your systems perform under pressure globally. Never stop learning. We invest in your growth, helping you sharpen your skills in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and advanced observability. Global impact, real users. Your work ensures millions of fans experience sports technology uninterrupted. Ready to Make an Impact? If you’re a skilled backend engineer who thrives on solving complex production challenges, passionate about high-availability infrastructure, and ready to lead technical resolution for real-time sports experiences, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

review_candidates.title: AI Engineer & Technical Co-Founder
review_candidates.description: AI Engineer & Technical Co-Founder — Owlera About Owlera Owlera is an AI-powered career and professional experience platform built to solve one of the biggest challenges facing students and early-career talent: you need experience to get opportunities, but you need opportunities to gain experience. We turn real company work into immersive virtual simulated internships where students complete professional missions, work with company resources, interact with AI managers, receive feedback and evaluation, and build verified evidence of what they can actually do. Our vision goes beyond courses and traditional job simulations. We are building an AI-powered environment where people can build experience, prove their abilities, and prepare for a rapidly changing world of work. About the Opportunity We are looking for an exceptional AI Engineer to join Owlera as a technical co-founder/founding technical partner and take ownership of the AI intelligence behind the platform. This is not a role focused on simply connecting an application to an LLM API. We need someone who can architect and build production AI systems that become core parts of the Owlera experience. You would work directly with the founder to transform our validated MVP into a scalable AI-powered platform and help shape both the product and technical direction of the company. What You'll Do You will design and build Owlera's AI architecture and core AI product capabilities, including: • AI agents and multi-step agentic workflows • AI Managers and Supervisors that guide students through realistic work experiences • AI evaluators that assess student submissions, provide feedback, score performance, and identify skills and professional behaviors • RAG systems that allow AI agents to understand company documents, resources, processes, and internship context • LLM integrations, orchestration, tool calling, memory, context management, and structured outputs • Conversational AI and intelligent chat experiences • AI-powered internship and mission generation from real company information • Career intelligence and personalized AI guidance • Reliable evaluation pipelines, guardrails, monitoring, testing, and AI quality improvement • Backend integrations required to connect these AI systems with the wider Owlera product You will also help determine what should be handled by agents, traditional software, retrieval systems, workflows, or other AI approaches as the platform scales. What We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is both a strong AI engineer and a builder. You should have hands-on experience with LLM applications, AI agents, agentic workflows, RAG, embeddings/vector databases, tool calling, structured outputs, prompt and context engineering, and production AI systems. Experience with Python and modern backend development is important. Full-stack experience is a major advantage because this is an early-stage company where technical ownership will extend beyond isolated AI models. Most importantly, we want someone who thinks like a founder: someone comfortable with ambiguity, fast experimentation, technical ownership, product decisions, and building from an early stage. Experience in EdTech, HRTech, Future of Work, assessment systems, recommendation systems, or AI evaluation is valuable but not required. Important: This Is a Co-Founder Opportunity This is not a salaried position at this stage. Owlera is currently pre-seed and raising capital. We are looking for a technical partner who believes in the problem and wants to help build the company from the ground up in exchange for co-founder equity, with compensation becoming possible as the company raises funding and grows. This opportunity is best suited for someone who wants more than their next engineering job. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the technology, product, team, and company alongside the founder. Learn more about Owlera: www.owlera.online

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer - Remote - Immediate joiners only.
review_candidates.description: Immediate joiners only. Compensation: ₹9L to ₹23L per annum , and it grows with every milestone we hit. Xuman.AI is a social app where people post content about what they are open to sharing and experiencing. Someone can discover them by scrolling , and if it resonates and vibes with them , they can connect instantly. On the surface, it collapses fragmented workflows into one system. Underneath, we are building something far deeper: The Human Experience Engine, our Persona Compatibility layer. This engine matches the right person with the right fit at the right time, based on who they are, what they want, and how they connect. The founder's vision is to layer cognitive science into human persona compatibility , leading to hyper-personalized, real-time human connections. Xuman.AI is the productization of the founder's previous bootstrapped venture: ideation, market research, pilots, MVP, and a technical foundation built to scale. The product is built and live on both app stores. We are past the building phase and into distribution: getting it in front of real users and turning it into a repeatable business. Why this role matters: Building a product from zero is experience you can find at almost any company. So is maintaining one that has already scaled. The stage in between is rare: a live product meeting real users, where fast, focused iteration decides what someone feels the first time they open it. Xuman.AI is in that stage now, and this role builds that first experience, end to end. What you'll own: - Features built end to end: screen, endpoint, data model, migration - Flows people depend on: discovery, booking, scheduling, checkout, rescheduling - What happens when they break, including cancellation and refund paths - Your work after it ships, not only until it merges - Real decisions about how your part of the product is built Must have: - Two to three years full stack, shipping to production - Strong production React, and a Node backend behind it with a real database - TypeScript on both ends. Our stack is TypeScript end to end. - REST APIs you designed and did not break for the people calling them - A relational database you modelled yourself. Ours is PostgreSQL with Prisma. - You handle the failure path: timeouts, retries, and the state a user is left in - Dates and time zones done correctly, because a booking is two people and one clock - You care what happens after the merge, not only whether it merged - Comfortable reading a service you did not write before you change it - You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) daily to write, debug, and ship faster. Not optional; this is how we work. What you'll get: - Features that are yours end to end, not tickets off someone else's board - Real say in how your part of the product gets built - Your work in real hands the same week, on a product that is live today - The lead seat above you as a real next step, and pay that grows with the milestones - Claude and Copilot from day one; we build with them, not around them You are joining before growth, not after. What you own here is real, and it grows as fast as you do. If this seat reads like yours, apply with confidence. Every application is reviewed personally.
